tasks.task: Explain how repository scanning applies nested ignore files, project override rules, and protected metadata exclusions; include the focused regression that verifies a project override wins over a nested ignore file.

task_roles.description: Ignore rule precedence and protected exclusions.

answer_assertions.description: The scanner extends inherited rules for each reached directory; nested ignore files apply only below their directory and are read after that directory is reachable.
The focused test keeps pkg/keep.log despite a nested *.log exclusion and excludes pkg/blocked.py despite a nested negation, reporting the project override as the exclusion source.
Ordinary rules run in default, inherited Git, then project override order with later matches winning; protected metadata is checked first and cannot be negated.

tasks.task: Review normalize_relative_path and its focused tests: explain separator normalization, dot segments, and rejection of absolute or escaping paths.

answer_assertions.description: normalize_relative_path converts backslashes to slashes, drops empty and dot segments, resolves internal parent segments, and preserves Unicode components.
Empty, root-only, drive-qualified, absolute, and above-root paths raise ValueError; a normalized path must retain a component.

tasks.task: Explain how consolidated session notes are sanitized before storage and how retained working-set context is bounded and evicted; include the focused privacy and growth tests.

answer_assertions.description: Credential-shaped text is replaced with [REDACTED]; merged active tasks, priorities and note text are redacted before storage.
Tests verify bucket lengths and summary tokens while preserving a pinned path, and retain provenance while removing supplied API-key and password values.
Buckets are deduplicated and capped; retention orders pinned, relevant, recent turn, then priority, with further eviction above 4000 estimated summary tokens.

tasks.task: Review createActiveModelAuthenticationRecovery and its focused tests. Which failures trigger recovery, what credential state changes, and how are other providers and token values handled?

answer_assertions.description: OAuth credentials with numeric expiry get only a lowered expires marker; the hook returns whether a credential was marked.
Recovery proceeds only for openai-codex AUTH failures with a credential service modify method; abort checks precede service access and credential mutation.
Tests verify early-revoked expiry recovery preserves access/refresh values, and another provider does not invoke credential modification.

tasks.task: Проследи, как переключение завершённости задачи проходит через сохранение и меняет напоминания. Объясни порядок действий, реальное хранение данных и ограничения текущего планировщика уведомлений.

answer_assertions.description: Completion toggle inverts isCompleted and calls the ViewModel save method, which launches container.saveTask in viewModelScope.
The container supplies an in-memory repository and demo reminder scheduler to SaveTask; saving replaces the same task ID and data lasts only for process lifetime.
DemoReminderScheduler schedule and cancel return Unit and create no system notifications.
SaveTask saves the task, cancels its previous reminder, then schedules only an incomplete task with a non-null reminderAt.

tasks.task: Review Translations.text and Translations.quantity with their focused tests. Explain missing or malformed translation fallback, plural locale selection, and handling of placeholders inside user-provided text.

task_roles.description: Plural, fallback and literal user-text tests.

answer_assertions.description: Missing or incompatible plural groups use English group and locale; quantity rejects negative counts and uses a category with other fallback.
Translations with mismatched placeholders fall back to English; missing strings use English, while unknown string keys are returned as keys.
Template substitution runs once, preserving braces introduced by user argument text; the test retains {title} in a supplied title.

tasks.task: Trace how an administrator ban is persisted and prevents a room participant from reconnecting. Explain matching by profile or IP, the storage update boundary, and the focused persistence regression.

task_roles.description: Admin ban and room connection guard.

answer_assertions.description: The guarded admin route validates action and profile ID, protects administrator targets, persists a generated ban, broadcasts the change and disconnects affected sockets.
Updates serialize through pendingWrite, clone current state, write a unique temporary file and rename it before publishing normalized state.
The regression creates a ban, reopens storage, finds the ban by profile ID and verifies only state.json remains.
Room middleware resolves IP and profile ID, invokes moderationBlock and rejects matching bans; matchingBan accepts either a nonempty profile ID or IP match.

tasks.task: Review compatiblePlaybackPlan and its focused tests: when does browser fallback become required, how is the audio track chosen, and when is audio copied rather than transcoded?

answer_assertions.description: Fallback is required for High 10 H.264 or any FLAC audio stream in Matroska; normal H.264/AAC MP4 returns required false.
Required fallback uses client-error trigger, video transcode and HLS output; selected AAC/MP3 audio is copied, other audio transcoded, absent audio none.
Default-marked audio wins over first audio; FLAC detection checks every audio stream, and the non-default FLAC test still selects default AAC.
